# `audit` operations

The exact fields each `audit.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `audit.list`

Query the audit log (tamper-evident per-row hashes).

`POST /v1/audit.list` · MCP `loom_audit_list` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str \| None` | `None` | None: every namespace the caller may read; naming one it cannot read gives an empty page. |
| `event_type` | `str \| None` | `None` | exact match |
| `since` | `datetime \| None` | `None` | only rows ts >= since |
| `limit` | `int` | `50` | At most this many rows per page, newest first; 1 to 500. |
| `cursor` | `str \| None` | `None` | opaque token from prior page |
| `fields` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | The output fields the caller reads (a whitelist resolved against the row model; an unknown name is a 422); unset, every field. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `list[AuditListRow]` | The page of audit rows, newest first (ties broken by `request_id`). |
| `next_cursor` | `str \| None` | Pass back as `cursor` for the next, older page; None when this page is the last. |

<!-- prettier-ignore-end -->
